text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat_treatment field is '---', which contradicts note N3 that specifies case hardening to 55–60 HRC with a 0.8–1.2 mm case depth. This conflict can cause the part to be manufactured without the required hardness, leading to premature wear or failure. The designer should update the title block heat_treatment field to match note N3.","recommended_correction":"Change the title block heat_treatment field from '---' to reference the case hardening requirement in note N3."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D9","page":1,"quote":"20.1±0.02"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"IZBP"}],"comment":"Dimension D9 has a tolerance band of 0.04 mm (±0.02), which is less than 0.1 mm, on a part that receives an IZBP plating per the surface_treatment field. Plating thickness is not accounted for, so the finished dimension will exceed the specified tolerance and may prevent proper assembly. The designer should adjust the pre-plating dimension to allow for the expected coating buildup.","recommended_correction":"Reduce the nominal size or widen the tolerance of D9 by the expected IZBP plating thickness so the final coated part remains within functional limits."}]}
